svg.aria-label: OOpolis, drawn as a small workshop on a bench. Queen OO, wearing a crown, stands on a tower beside a switchboard with a card hopper on top. Three pneumatic tubes leave the switchboard on hangers and drop to three desks, where a small OO robot sits on a stool at each: Inbox Zero, Morning Brief and Research Desk. Every desk carries its connected apps as small devices, a clock showing when its routine runs, a stack of coins for its monthly budget, a rack of skill cartridges, a lamp that lights when it needs your OK and a flag it raises when it has a question. A conveyor in front carries finished work, approvals and questions into one Inbox tray, beside an approval lever.
